title: bug: archive_epic's own EPIC_UPDATED (status → ARCHIVED) records no actor, though the same call's TASK_ARCHIVED events have recorded the caller since 1064df99 (residual of the 3e1d0c2e actor fix)
description:
Filed by governor-e6b40560 from architect-24611a0a's residual note on task-3e1d0c2e (#governors msg-76075bb1, 18:59Z).

PROBLEM (verified at moe/work-2026-10-24 b5f40fee)
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/archiveEpic.ts:86 records the caller on each TASK_ARCHIVED: `state.updateTask(task.id, archiveUpdates(task), 'TASK_ARCHIVED', params.workerId)`, landed by 1064df99 (b9119a93).
- The same call then archives the epic at :92 with `state.updateEpic(params.epicId, { status: 'ARCHIVED' })`, which passes no actor. So the EPIC_UPDATED event for the archive has no workerId, and get_activity_log { workerId } misses it.
- task-3e1d0c2e (WORKING) adds an optional actorWorkerId to StateManager.updateEpic for update_epic. Once it lands, this fix is one argument plus a test.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE
StateManager.ts:1434, the EPIC_UPDATED written when a human approves a rail proposal. The architect left it actor-less on purpose.

DEPENDENCY
dependsOn task-3e1d0c2e, because this row needs its updateEpic actor parameter. Plan against that row's plan (an assumed interface: updateEpic(epicId, updates, actorWorkerId?)). WORKING claims wait until it is DONE.

Gate: narrow, per the epic-be924fb8 ruling msg-bbf4f109. Run archiveEpic's test file only.
definitionOfDone: archive_epic called with a workerId records that workerId as the actor on the epic's EPIC_UPDATED (status ARCHIVED) event, as well as on every TASK_ARCHIVED event, so get_activity_log { workerId } returns both kinds; a call without workerId still succeeds and records no actor.
A regression case in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/archiveEpic.test.ts fails before the fix and passes after it, and the rest of archiveEpic.test.ts still passes.
The rail-proposal approval EPIC_UPDATED in StateManager is unchanged.

implementationPlan.description:
Fix packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/archiveEpic.ts:
- Change the epic write (~:92) to exactly `const updatedEpic = epicWasArchived ? epic : await state.updateEpic(params.epicId, { status: 'ARCHIVED' }, params.workerId);`. The third argument is the actorWorkerId parameter that the dependsOn row task-3e1d0c2e adds to StateManager.updateEpic. updateEpic passes it to appendActivity as the 7th argument.
- Above that line, add a one-line comment: the caller is also the actor of the epic's own EPIC_UPDATED, and an idempotent re-archive writes nothing. Keep the `epicWasArchived ? epic :` short-circuit.
- In inputSchema.properties.workerId.description (~:41), change 'recorded as the actor of each TASK_ARCHIVED, and a BLOCKED row…' to 'recorded as the actor of each TASK_ARCHIVED and of the epic\'s EPIC_UPDATED, and a BLOCKED row…'.
- Pass the bare params.workerId. Never use `?? 'unknown'`, `|| 'agent'` or the assignee. A caller-less call passes undefined and records no actor.

Docs: in docs/MCP_SERVER.md, section `### moe.archive_epic` (~:1784-1806), make two edits:
- The sentence 'Each `TASK_ARCHIVED` records the caller's `workerId` as its actor.' becomes 'Each `TASK_ARCHIVED`, and the epic's own `EPIC_UPDATED` (status `ARCHIVED`), records the caller's `workerId` as its actor; a call without one records none.'
- The workerId comment in the Parameters block becomes '// Caller (auto-injected by moe-proxy); recorded as the actor of each TASK_ARCHIVED and of the epic's EPIC_UPDATED; a BLOCKED task held by another worker refuses the archive'.

Touch nothing else. These stay byte-identical:
- state/StateManager.ts, including the rail-proposal approval's `await this.updateEpic(epic.id, { epicRails: rails });` (DoD 3);
- server/WebSocketServer.ts;
- tools/archiveTask.ts.

Error handling is unchanged. missingRequired, notFound, the in-flight NOT_ALLOWED, the holder-only NOT_ALLOWED and ATTEMPT_FINALIZING keep their order and still refuse before any write. The audit append stays best-effort: appendActivity never throws into the caller.

Edit both files with the session's own editing tool: Edit on a Claude seat, apply_patch on a codex exec seat. Never use Serena on docs/ (it ignores docs/), and never a shell write. The code reference is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-c927e484/reference-fix.diff.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: moe.archive_epic records the caller's workerId (auto-injected by moe-proxy) as the top-level workerId of the epic's own EPIC_UPDATED (status → ARCHIVED). It already does this on every TASK_ARCHIVED, so get_activity_log { workerId } returns both kinds. A call without workerId still succeeds and records no actor on either kind. An idempotent re-archive of an already-ARCHIVED epic writes nothing and so records nothing. The rail-proposal approval's EPIC_UPDATED in StateManager stays actor-less, and its code is untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: After archive_epic { epicId, workerId: X }, get_activity_log { workerId: X } returns the epic's EPIC_UPDATED (payload { epicId, changedFields: ['status'], status: 'ARCHIVED' }) and one TASK_ARCHIVED for each task it archived.
archive_epic without workerId succeeds, and its EPIC_UPDATED and TASK_ARCHIVED events have no workerId. Seats 'unknown' and 'agent' match none of them.
A second archive_epic on the archived epic, by another seat, writes no event, and that seat's get_activity_log stays empty.

Case (e1) in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/archiveEpic.test.ts fails against the unfixed archiveEpic.ts: checkRef red requires exactly 1 failed test. It passes after the fix, and the rest of archiveEpic.test.ts and archiveEpic.holderActor.test.ts still pass (checkRef green).

invariants: The actor comes only from archive_epic's own params.workerId. It is never replaced by a placeholder ('unknown', 'agent', the assignee).
The EPIC_UPDATED and TASK_ARCHIVED payloads and their epicId/taskId fields are unchanged.
Refusals keep their order and codes (missingRequired, notFound, in-flight NOT_ALLOWED, holder-only NOT_ALLOWED, ATTEMPT_FINALIZING), and a refused call writes nothing.
An already-ARCHIVED epic is never rewritten. appendActivity stays best-effort.
compatibility: archive_epic's inputSchema changes only in the workerId description text. The return shape and all error codes are unchanged.
